exercises.instructionEn: Look at the pictures on p. 112, then read the statements and mark them as T (true) or F (false).
exercises.instructionUz: 112-betdagi rasmlarga qarang, so'ngra gaplarni o'qing va T (to'g'ri) yoki F (noto'g'ri) deb belgilang.
exercises.explanationUz:
BARCHA JAVOBLAR:
  1  T
  2  F
  3  T
  4  F


HAR BIRI — 112-BETDAN DALIL:

 1  'There are THREE aliens inside the
     spaceship.'
    1-kadrda UCHTA o'zga sayyoralik ko'rinadi,
    3-kadrda ham UCHTA.
    → T

 2  'The aliens have got LONG CURLY HAIR.'
    Rasmda o'zga sayyoraliklar butunlay
    KAL — soch YO'Q!
    → F

 3  'The aliens are wearing LONG ROBES.'
    Rasmda ular uzun, rangli (sariq, qizil,
    yashil) libos kiygan.
    → T

 4  'David and Sandra are IN THE SPACESHIP in
     the LAST picture.'
    OXIRGI kadr ustida yozilgan:
    'IN THE HOTEL ...'
    Ular MEHMONXONADA, kemada emas!
    → F


⚠ 4-BAND — ENG NOZIK:
  Kitob 'the LAST picture' deydi.
  112-betdagi OXIRGI kadr ustida ANIQ
  yozilgan: 'IN THE HOTEL ...'

  Kemada bo'lgan kadrlar — 1, 2, 3
  ('INSIDE THE SPACESHIP ...').


DIQQAT — 'CURLY HAIR':
  curly hair    = jingalak soch
  straight hair = tekis soch
  wavy hair     = to'lqinsimon soch

  'hair' — SANALMAYDIGAN:
     'long hair'  ✓
     'long hairs' ✗


DIQQAT — 'A ROBE':
  'a robe' = uzun libos, xalat
  (rasmiy yoki diniy kiyim).

  'to WEAR' — kiyib turmoq (holat)
  'to PUT ON' — kiymoq (harakat)


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  curly       = jingalak
  hair        = soch (SANALMAYDIGAN)
  to wear     = kiyib turmoq
  a robe      = uzun libos
  the last picture = oxirgi rasm

exercises.instructionEn: Look at the last picture on p. 112. Why are David and Sandra surprised?
exercises.instructionUz: 112-betdagi oxirgi rasmga qarang. Nega Devid va Sandra hayron?
exercises.explanationUz:
JAVOB:

  'They are surprised because the pictures
   show a spaceship and aliens, but they
   don't remember taking them. They don't
   remember what happened.'

  Tarjimasi:
  'Ular hayron, chunki suratlarda kosmik kema
   va o'zga sayyoraliklar ko'rinadi, lekin
   ular bu suratlarni olganini eslamaydi.
   Ular nima bo'lganini eslamaydi.'


SABABI IKKI TOMONLAMA:

  1) SURATLARDA g'ayrioddiy narsa bor —
     kosmik kema va o'zga sayyoraliklar.

  2) Ular bu suratlarni OLGANINI ESLAMAYDI —
     xotiralari o'chirilgan.

  Ya'ni: DALIL bor, XOTIRA yo'q.


112-BETDAN DALILLAR:

  5-kadr:
     'Did we take any? I DON'T REMEMBER.'
     'No, I DON'T, but I can see the camera
      is on automatic.'

  6-kadr:
     'Sandra, you WON'T BELIEVE this.'
     'What? A spaceship? Aliens? But HOW?
      WHEN? WHAT HAPPENED?'
     'I CAN'T ANSWER these questions.'

  Sandraning uchta savoli ('how? when? what
  happened?') hayronlikni ochiq ko'rsatadi.


BOShQA MUMKIN JAVOBLAR:

  'Because they can see aliens and a
   spaceship in the pictures.'

  'Because they took the pictures but they
   can't remember doing it.'

  'Because the aliens erased their memories.'


DIQQAT — 'SURPRISED' va 'SURPRISING':
  'They are SURPRISED.' — odam (his)
  'It is SURPRISING.' — narsa (xususiyat)

  Coursebook 105-bet: 'fascinating' /
  'fascinated' bilan bir xil qoida.


DIQQAT — 'REMEMBER + -ING':
  'I don't remember TAKING them.'
  = olganimni eslamayman

  FARQI:
     'remember DOING' = qilganini eslamoq
        (ish QILINGAN)
     'remember TO DO' = qilishni eslamoq
        (ish hali qilinmagan)

  Bu yerda suratlar OLINGAN, shuning uchun
  '-ING'.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  surprised   = hayron
  to remember = eslamoq
  to show     = ko'rsatmoq
  to happen   = sodir bo'lmoq

points.en: They are surprised because the pictures show a spaceship and aliens, but they don't remember taking them.

SABAB IKKI TOMONLAMA:
1) suratlarda g'ayrioddiy narsa bor;
2) ular olganini ESLAMAYDI.

DALIL bor, XOTIRA yo'q.

points.en: They don't remember what happened. The aliens erased their memories.
points.uz: Ular nima bo'lganini eslamaydi. O'zga sayyoraliklar xotiralarini o'chirgan.
points.noteUz:
112-bet, 6-kadr — Sandraning uchta savoli:
'But HOW? WHEN? WHAT HAPPENED?'

Hayronlikni ochiq ko'rsatadi.

'remember DOING' = qilganini eslamoq.

exercises.instructionEn: Read the sentences. The words in bold are opposites. Explain them, then listen and underline the correct word.
exercises.instructionUz: Gaplarni o'qing. Qalin harfdagi so'zlar zid ma'noli. Ularni tushuntiring, so'ngra tinglang va to'g'ri so'zning tagiga chizing.
exercises.explanationUz:
DIQQAT — AUDIO ShART EMAS:
  Oltala javob 112-betdagi komiksda
  SO'ZMA-SO'Z bor.


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:
  1  HUMAN
  2  PRIMITIVE
  3  JOIN
  4  ERASE
  5  FULL OF
  6  BEST


OLTI ZID JUFTLIK — TUShUNTIRISh:

 1  HUMAN ↔ ALIEN
    human = odam (Yer aholisi)
    alien = o'zga sayyoralik

 2  MODERN ↔ PRIMITIVE
    modern = zamonaviy
    primitive = ibtidoiy, oddiy

 3  JOIN ↔ LEAVE
    to join = qo'shilmoq
    to leave = tark etmoq, ketmoq

 4  BRING BACK ↔ ERASE
    to bring back = qaytarmoq (xotirani)
    to erase = o'chirib tashlamoq

 5  EMPTY ↔ FULL OF
    empty = bo'sh
    full of = ... ga to'la

 6  BEST ↔ WORST
    the best = eng yaxshi (good → better →
       the best)
    the worst = eng yomon (bad → worse →
       the worst)


HAR BIRI — 112-BETDAN DALIL:

 1  1-kadr: 'And this here is a male HUMAN.'
    O'zga sayyoralik odamlarni ko'rsatyapti,
    o'zini emas.

 2  2-kadr: 'Very PRIMITIVE means of
    transport.'
    O'zga sayyoraliklar mashinani ibtidoiy
    deb baholaydi.

 3  3-kadr: 'They are not ready to JOIN us.'
    Ular odamlar hali ularga qo'shilishga
    tayyor emas deb hisoblaydi.

 4  3-kadr: 'ERASE their memories and send
    them back.'

 5  5-kadr: 'The film is FULL OF pictures.'

 6  6-kadr: 'This is going to be our BEST
    story.'


⚠ MANTIQIY TEKShIRUV — HAR JAVOB HIKOYAGA
MOS KELADI:

  1  Agar 'alien' bo'lsa: o'zga sayyoralik
     o'z turdoshini 'erkak o'zga sayyoralik'
     deb tanishtirar edi — lekin ular
     ODAMLARNI o'rganyapti.

  2  Agar 'modern' bo'lsa: o'zga
     sayyoraliklar mashinani zamonaviy deb
     maqtar edi — lekin ular texnologik
     jihatdan ancha ustun.

  3  Agar 'leave' bo'lsa: 'bizni tark
     etishga tayyor emas' — mantiqsiz
     (odamlar ularni tanimaydi ham).

  4  Agar 'Bring back' bo'lsa: xotirani
     qaytarish — lekin keyingi epizodda ular
     ESLAMAYDI.

  5  Agar 'empty' bo'lsa: 'plyonka bo'sh' —
     lekin keyin suratlarni yuvishadi va
     kema surati chiqadi.

  6  Agar 'worst' bo'lsa: Devid xursand emas,
     xafa bo'lardi — lekin u hayajonda.


DIQQAT — 'FULL OF':
  'full OF something' — predlog 'of' SHART.
     'full of pictures'  ✓
     'full pictures'     ✗

  Coursebook 111-bet: 'a city FULL OF
  wonderful sights' (Workbook 60-bet,
  1-mashq).


DIQQAT — 'BRING BACK':
  'to bring back a memory' = xotirani
  qaytarmoq (esga solmoq)

  Ajraladigan fe'l:
     bring it back  ✓
     bring back it  ✗


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  human      = odam
  an alien   = o'zga sayyoralik
  modern     = zamonaviy
  primitive  = ibtidoiy
  to join    = qo'shilmoq
  to leave   = tark etmoq
  to bring back = qaytarmoq
  to erase   = o'chirmoq
  empty      = bo'sh
  full of    = ... ga to'la
  the best   = eng yaxshi
  the worst  = eng yomon

items.textEn: 1  And this here is a male human/alien.
items.whyUz:
112-bet, 1-kadr so'zma-so'z:
'And this here is a male HUMAN.'

ZID JUFTLIK: human (odam) ↔ alien (o'zga
sayyoralik).

MANTIQ: o'zga sayyoraliklar ODAMLARNI
o'rganyapti, o'z turdoshini emas.

112-bet, 2-kadr so'zma-so'z:
'Very PRIMITIVE means of transport.'

ZID JUFTLIK: modern ↔ primitive.

MANTIQ: o'zga sayyoraliklar texnologik
jihatdan ancha ustun, shuning uchun mashinani
IBTIDOIY deb baholaydi.

items.textEn: 3  They are not ready to join/leave us.
items.whyUz:
112-bet, 3-kadr so'zma-so'z:
'They are not ready to JOIN us.'

ZID JUFTLIK: join (qo'shilmoq) ↔ leave
(tark etmoq).

MANTIQ: 'bizni tark etishga tayyor emas' —
mantiqsiz, chunki odamlar ularni tanimaydi
ham.

112-bet, 3-kadr so'zma-so'z:
'ERASE their memories and send them back.'

ZID JUFTLIK: bring back (qaytarmoq) ↔ erase
(o'chirmoq).

MANTIQ: keyingi kadrda ular hech narsani
ESLAMAYDI — demak xotira O'CHIRILGAN.

items.textEn: 5  The film is empty/full of pictures.
items.whyUz:
112-bet, 5-kadr so'zma-so'z:
'The film is FULL OF pictures.'

ZID JUFTLIK: empty (bo'sh) ↔ full of (to'la).

MANTIQ: agar plyonka bo'sh bo'lsa, uni
yuvishga hojat qolmasdi — lekin ular yuvadi
va kema surati chiqadi.

'full OF' — predlog 'of' SHART.

items.textEn: 6  This is going to be our best/worst story.
items.uz: Bu bizning eng yaxshi maqolamiz bo'ladi.
items.whyUz:
112-bet, 6-kadr so'zma-so'z:
'This is going to be our BEST story.'

ZID JUFTLIK: the best ↔ the worst.
  good → better → THE BEST
  bad → worse → THE WORST

MANTIQ: Devid HAYAJONDA ('you won't believe
this!'), xafa emas.

exercises.instructionEn: Read the episode and answer the questions.
exercises.instructionUz: Epizodni o'qing va savollarga javob bering.
exercises.explanationUz:
BESh SAVOL — BARCHA JAVOBLAR:

 1  What is the 'metal box' that the alien
    mentions?
    → It is the car (the jeep).
    (Bu — mashina (jip).)

 2  Why do the aliens decide to erase David's
    and Sandra's memories?
    → Because they are not ready to join them.
      They are still very primitive.
    (Chunki ular ularga qo'shilishga tayyor
     emas. Ular hali ham juda ibtidoiy.)

 3  What can't humans understand?
    → They can't understand the aliens'
      technology.
    (Ular o'zga sayyoraliklarning
     texnologiyasini tushuna olmaydi.)

 4  Why does David want to develop the film?
    → Because the film is full of pictures
      and he wants to see what's in it.
      (They don't remember taking any.)
    (Chunki plyonka suratlarga to'la va u
     ichida nima borligini ko'rmoqchi.)

 5  What do the pictures show?
    → They show a spaceship and aliens.
    (Ularda kosmik kema va o'zga
     sayyoraliklar ko'rinadi.)


HAR JAVOB — 112-BETDAN DALIL:

 1  2-kadr: 'And what was that METAL BOX they
    were in?' → 'They call it A CAR.'

 2  3-kadr: 'They are NOT READY TO JOIN us.
    ERASE their memories.'
    Yana: 'They are still very PRIMITIVE.'

 3  3-kadr: 'They will not be able to
    understand OUR TECHNOLOGY.'

 4  5-kadr: 'The film is FULL OF PICTURES...
    Let's DEVELOP the film and SEE WHAT'S IN
    IT.'

 5  6-kadr: 'A SPACESHIP? ALIENS?'
    Yana rasmda devorda NUJO surati osilgan.


⚠ 1-SAVOL — 'METAL BOX' NIMA:

  O'zga sayyoraliklar mashinani tanimaydi,
  shuning uchun uni 'metall quti' deb
  ataydi.

  Bu — badiiy usul: notanish narsani
  BEGONA nigoh bilan tasvirlash.

  Ikkinchi o'zga sayyoralik tushuntiradi:
  'THEY CALL IT a car.'
  ('they' = odamlar)


⚠ 2-SAVOL — IKKI SABAB:

  Xotira o'chirilishining sababi:
     a) 'They are NOT READY TO JOIN us.'
     b) 'They are still very PRIMITIVE.'
     c) 'They WILL NOT BE ABLE TO UNDERSTAND
         our technology.'

  Uchalasini ham aytish mumkin.


DIQQAT — EGALIK ShAKLI:
  'David'S and Sandra'S memories'

  IKKI odam alohida bo'lsa, HAR IKKALASIGA
  apostrof qo'yiladi:
     'David's and Sandra's memories'
     (har birining o'z xotirasi)

  Agar BIRGALIKDAGI narsa bo'lsa, faqat
  oxirgisiga:
     'David and Sandra's car'
     (bitta mashina, ikkalasiniki)


DIQQAT — 'THE ALIENS' TECHNOLOGY':
  Ko'plik otda apostrof '-S' DAN KEYIN:
     'the alienS' technology'  ✓
     'the alien'S technology'  — bitta o'zga
        sayyoralik degan ma'no


DIQQAT — 'TO MENTION':
  'the metal box that the alien MENTIONS'
  'to mention' = tilga olmoq

  Grammar 64-bet: 'the time is not
  MENTIONED'.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  to mention  = tilga olmoq
  to decide   = qaror qilmoq
  technology  = texnologiya
  to develop  = (plyonkani) yuvmoq
  to show     = ko'rsatmoq

exercises.instructionEn: Match the sentences, then underline the correct linking word.
exercises.instructionUz: Gaplarni moslang, so'ngra to'g'ri bog'lovchining tagiga chizing.
exercises.explanationUz:
BARCHA JAVOBLAR:

  1  →  c  (BECAUSE)   — KITOBDA STRELKA
  2  →  e  (BUT)
  3  →  g  (SO)
  4  →  a  (BECAUSE)
  5  →  d  (SO)
  6  →  b  (BUT)
  7  →  f  (BECAUSE)


TO'LIQ GAPLAR:

 1  'David and Sandra are driving near
     Myrrhee BECAUSE they want to write a
     story about UFOs.'
    (KITOBDA STRELKA CHIZILGAN)

 2  'The jeep slows down, BUT Sandra and
     David don't know why.'

 3  'They see a spaceship, SO David asks
     Sandra to take some pictures.'

 4  'The aliens take them into the spaceship
     BECAUSE they want to study them.'

 5  'The aliens think David and Sandra are
     very primitive, SO they erase their
     memories and send them back.'

 6  'David finds the film is full of
     pictures, BUT he doesn't remember using
     the camera.'

 7  'They are surprised when they see the
     pictures BECAUSE they are pictures of
     aliens and a spaceship.'


⚠ UCh BOG'LOVChINING FARQI:

  BECAUSE = chunki (SABAB)
     [natija] BECAUSE [sabab]
     'They are driving BECAUSE they want to
      write a story.'

  SO = shuning uchun (NATIJA)
     [sabab] SO [natija]
     'They see a spaceship, SO David asks
      Sandra to take pictures.'

  BUT = lekin (QARAMA-QARShILIK)
     [1-fikr] BUT [zid fikr]
     'The jeep slows down, BUT they don't
      know why.'


⚠ 'BECAUSE' va 'SO' — TESKARI TARTIB:

  Bir xil ma'noni ikki xil aytish mumkin:

     'They see a spaceship, SO David asks
      Sandra to take pictures.'
            ↑sabab      ↑natija

     'David asks Sandra to take pictures
      BECAUSE they see a spaceship.'
            ↑natija        ↑sabab

  Ya'ni 'so' va 'because' TARTIBI teskari!


HAR BIRI NEGA:

 1  'driving near Myrrhee' + 'they want to
    write a story'
    Haydashning SABABI → BECAUSE.

 2  'The jeep slows down' + 'they don't know
    why'
    Bu — QARAMA-QARShILIK (sekinlashdi,
    LEKIN sababi noma'lum) → BUT.

 3  'They see a spaceship' + 'David asks
    Sandra to take pictures'
    Kemani ko'rish — SABAB;
    surat olish — NATIJA → SO.

 4  'The aliens take them into the spaceship'
    + 'they want to study them'
    Olib kirishning SABABI → BECAUSE.

 5  'The aliens think they are primitive' +
    'they erase their memories'
    Fikr — SABAB; xotirani o'chirish —
    NATIJA → SO.

 6  'David finds the film is full of
    pictures' + 'he doesn't remember using
    the camera'
    QARAMA-QARShILIK (suratlar bor, LEKIN
    eslamaydi) → BUT.

 7  'They are surprised' + 'they are pictures
    of aliens'
    Hayronlikning SABABI → BECAUSE.


⚠ MANTIQIY ZANJIR (hikoya tartibida):
  1 → 2 → 3 → 4 → 5 → 6 → 7

  Bandlar hikoyaning KETMA-KETLIGIDA
  berilgan — bu ham yordam beradi.


DIQQAT — 'REMEMBER USING':
  'he doesn't remember USING the camera'
  'remember + -ING' = qilganini eslamoq

  (1b-mashqda ham shu qoida bor edi.)


DIQQAT — 'ASK SOMEBODY TO DO':
  'David ASKS Sandra TO TAKE some pictures.'
  'ask somebody TO do something' — kimdandir
  biror ishni qilishni so'ramoq.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a linking word = bog'lovchi
  because     = chunki
  so          = shuning uchun
  but         = lekin
  to study    = o'rganmoq
  to use      = foydalanmoq

QARAMA-QARSHILIK: jip sekinlashdi, LEKIN

'so' bu yerda mos kelmaydi (sekinlashish
bilmaslikka sabab bo'lmaydi).

pairs.whyUz:
Kemani ko'rish — SABAB;
surat olish — NATIJA → SO.

112-bet, 8-mashq xulosasi:
'DAVID ASKS SANDRA TO TAKE PICTURES.'

'ask somebody TO do' — qurilma.

pairs.left: 4  The aliens take them into the spaceship
pairs.right: a  BECAUSE they want to study them.
pairs.leftUz: O'zga sayyoraliklar ularni kemaga olib kirishadi
pairs.whyUz:
Olib kirishning SABABI → BECAUSE.

112-bet, 3-kadr:
'We have STUDIED similar humans before.'

pairs.left: 5  The aliens think David and Sandra are very primitive,
pairs.right: d  SO they erase their memories and send them back.
pairs.leftUz: O'zga sayyoraliklar Devid va Sandrani juda ibtidoiy deb hisoblaydi,
pairs.rightUz: shuning uchun xotiralarini o'chirib, ularni qaytarib yuborishadi.
pairs.whyUz:
Fikr — SABAB; xotirani o'chirish — NATIJA
→ SO.

112-bet, 3-kadr:
'They are still very PRIMITIVE ... ERASE
their memories and send them back.'

pairs.left: 6  David finds the film is full of pictures,
pairs.right: b  BUT he doesn't remember using the camera.
pairs.leftUz: Devid plyonka suratlarga to'la ekanini ko'radi,
pairs.whyUz:
QARAMA-QARSHILIK: suratlar BOR, LEKIN
eslamaydi → BUT.

112-bet, 5-kadr:
'Did we take any? I DON'T REMEMBER.'

'remember + -ING' = qilganini eslamoq.

pairs.left: 7  They are surprised when they see the pictures
pairs.right: f  BECAUSE they are pictures of aliens and a spaceship.
pairs.rightUz: chunki ular o'zga sayyoraliklar va kosmik kema suratlari.
pairs.whyUz:
Hayronlikning SABABI → BECAUSE.

112-bet, 6-kadr:
'What? A SPACESHIP? ALIENS?'

1b-mashqning javobi bilan bir xil.

exercises.instructionEn: Label the pictures with the words below. Which of these means of transport are primitive and which are modern?
exercises.instructionUz: Rasmlarni quyidagi so'zlar bilan nomlang. Bu transport vositalaridan qaysilari ibtidoiy va qaysilari zamonaviy?
exercises.explanationUz:
RO'YXAT (9 ta so'z, 9 ta rasm):
  cart, aeroplane, train, car, donkeys,
  camel, rowing boat, raft, hot air balloon


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:
  1  CART            (arava)
  2  AEROPLANE       (samolyot)
  3  TRAIN           (poyezd)
  4  RAFT            (sol)
  5  ROWING BOAT     (eshkakli qayiq)
  6  HOT AIR BALLOON (havo shari)
  7  CAMEL           (tuya)
  8  DONKEYS         (eshaklar)
  9  CAR             (mashina)


RASMLARDA NIMA KO'RINADI:
  1  Ot tortayotgan yopiq arava
  2  Osmonda uchayotgan katta samolyot
  3  Qizil 'CN' yozuvli lokomotiv
  4  Daryoda yog'och sol (odamlar ustida)
  5  Sohildagi rangli yog'och qayiq
  6  Rang-barang havo shari
  7  Tuya
  8  Yuk ortilgan eshaklar
  9  Qizil sport mashinasi


⚠ IKKINChI SAVOL — IBTIDOIY yoki ZAMONAVIY:

  PRIMITIVE (ibtidoiy) — 5 ta:
     cart          (ot tortadi)
     rowing boat   (eshkak bilan)
     raft          (oqim bilan)
     camel         (hayvon)
     donkeys       (hayvon)

  MODERN (zamonaviy) — 4 ta:
     aeroplane     (dvigatel)
     train         (dvigatel)
     car           (dvigatel)
     hot air balloon (zamonaviy uchish
                      apparati)


QANDAY AJRATILADI:

  IBTIDOIY — HAYVON yoki ODAM kuchi bilan
     harakatlanadi, dvigatel YO'Q:
        cart — ot tortadi
        rowing boat — odam eshkak eshadi
        raft — daryo oqimi olib ketadi
        camel, donkeys — hayvonning o'zi

  ZAMONAVIY — MAShINA/DVIGATEL bilan:
        aeroplane, train, car

  DIQQAT — HAVO ShARI:
     Havo sharida dvigatel yo'q (issiq havo
     ko'taradi), lekin u ZAMONAVIY sanoat
     mahsuloti va zamonaviy uchish apparati
     hisoblanadi.

     Ba'zilar uni 'primitive' deb ham
     tasniflashi mumkin — bu munozarali.


⚠ BOG'LIQLIK — HIKOYA VA WORKBOOK:

  112-bet, 2-kadr:
     'They call it a car. Very PRIMITIVE
      MEANS OF TRANSPORT.'

  Workbook 60-bet, 3-mashqning 1-bandi:
     'Canoes are a PRIMITIVE MEANS OF
      TRANSPORT.'

  Bu mashq shu mavzuni davom ettiradi.


DIQQAT — 'A MEANS OF TRANSPORT':
  'means' — birlikda ham '-S' bilan!
     'a meanS of transport'   ✓
     'a mean of transport'    ✗
     'two meanS of transport' ✓


DIQQAT — 'DONKEYS' KO'PLIKDA:
  Ro'yxatda 'donkeys' (ko'plik) berilgan,
  chunki rasmda BIR NEChA eshak bor.

  Qolgan hammasi BIRLIKDA.


DIQQAT — 'A RAFT' va 'A ROWING BOAT':
  a raft = sol (bog'langan yog'ochlar)
  a rowing boat = eshkakli qayiq

  Ikkalasi ham suv transporti, lekin sol
  oddiyroq.


DIQQAT — 'A CART':
  a cart = arava (hayvon tortadigan)
  a carriage = arava (yo'lovchi uchun,
     chiroyliroq)
  a wagon = yuk aravasi


GAP TUZISh:
  'A cart is a primitive means of transport.'
  'An aeroplane is a modern means of
   transport.'
  'Camels and donkeys are primitive means of
   transport.'


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a cart        = arava
  an aeroplane  = samolyot
  a train       = poyezd
  a donkey      = eshak
  a camel       = tuya
  a rowing boat = eshkakli qayiq
  to row        = eshkak eshmoq
  a raft        = sol
  a hot air balloon = havo shari

pairs.whyUz:
Ot tortadi, dvigatel YO'Q → IBTIDOIY.

'a cart' = arava.
O'xshash so'zlar: a carriage (yo'lovchi
aravasi), a wagon (yuk aravasi).

Dvigatel bilan uchadi → ZAMONAVIY.

BRITANCHA: aeroplane
AMERIKACHA: airplane

Dvigatel bilan → ZAMONAVIY.

'travel BY train' — artiklsiz
(Grammar 66-bet).

Bog'langan yog'ochlar, daryo oqimi olib
ketadi → IBTIDOIY.

'a raft' = sol.
Eng qadimiy suv transportlaridan biri.

Odam ESHKAK eshadi, dvigatel YO'Q
→ IBTIDOIY.

'to row' = eshkak eshmoq.
'a rowing boat' = eshkakli qayiq.

Dvigateli yo'q (issiq havo ko'taradi), lekin
ZAMONAVIY sanoat mahsuloti va uchish
apparati → MODERN.

DIQQAT: bu bandni ba'zilar 'primitive' deb
ham tasniflashi mumkin — munozarali.

HAYVON kuchi bilan → IBTIDOIY.

Coursebook 104-105-betlar:
'I even RODE A CAMEL' (Jekning xati).

'ride ON a camel' — predlog 'on'.

HAYVON kuchi bilan → IBTIDOIY.

DIQQAT: ro'yxatda 'donkeys' KO'PLIKDA
berilgan, chunki rasmda bir necha eshak bor.
Qolgan hammasi BIRLIKDA.

Dvigatel bilan → ZAMONAVIY.

⚠ QIZIQ: 112-betda o'zga sayyoraliklar
mashinani 'very PRIMITIVE means of
transport' deb baholaydi — chunki ular
texnologik jihatdan ancha ustun!

Baho NISBIY.

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the correct form of the verbs in brackets.
exercises.instructionUz: Qavs ichidagi fe'llarning to'g'ri shaklini qo'ying.
exercises.explanationUz:
MATN — MYRRHEE HAQIDA HAQIQIY MA'LUMOT.


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:

   1  IS
   2  SAY
   3  HAVE SEEN
   4  IS
   5  ARE ALIENS
   6  COMPARED
   7  SUGGESTED
   8  KNEW
   9  IS
  10  LIVED
  11  ARRIVED
  12  DID THEY KNOW
  13  DID ALIENS TRY
  14  DON'T KNOW
  15  IS
  16  IS


TO'LIQ MATN (javoblar bilan):

  'Myrrhee IS a small place near the town of
   Moyhu in New South Wales, Australia. Many
   people SAY they HAVE SEEN UFOs in the
   area, but the big question IS this — why
   ARE ALIENS interested in Myrrhee?

   In the late 1960's, Erich von Däniken
   COMPARED some ancient Aboriginal rock
   paintings to modern descriptions of
   aliens. They SUGGESTED that the ancient
   Aborigines KNEW about aliens. Another
   interesting point IS that many Aborigines
   LIVED around the area of Myrrhee before
   the white man ARRIVED in the 18th century.
   DID THEY KNOW about aliens? DID ALIENS TRY
   to contact the Aborigines again?
   Unfortunately, we DON'T KNOW for sure. One
   thing IS certain, though — the truth IS
   still out there ...'


TO'LIQ TARJIMASI:

  'Myrrhee — Avstraliyaning Yangi Janubiy
   Uels shtatidagi Moyhu shahri yaqinidagi
   kichik joy. Ko'p odamlar bu hududda
   NUJOlarni ko'rganini aytadi, lekin katta
   savol shu — nega o'zga sayyoraliklar
   Myrrhee bilan qiziqadi?

   1960-yillarning oxirida Erix fon Deniken
   ba'zi qadimiy aborigen qoya rasmlarini
   o'zga sayyoraliklarning zamonaviy
   tasviriga qiyoslagan. Ular qadimgi
   aborigenlar o'zga sayyoraliklar haqida
   bilgan deb taxmin qilishgan. Yana bir
   qiziq jihat shundaki, oq tanlilar 18-asrda
   kelishidan oldin ko'plab aborigenlar
   Myrrhee atrofida yashagan. Ular o'zga
   sayyoraliklar haqida bilganmi? O'zga
   sayyoraliklar aborigenlar bilan yana
   aloqaga chiqmoqchi bo'lganmi? Afsuski,
   biz aniq bilmaymiz. Ammo bir narsa
   aniq — haqiqat hali ham qayerdadir...'


ZAMONLAR BO'YIChA GURUHLAR:

  PRESENT SIMPLE (doimiy haqiqat) —
     1, 2, 4, 5, 9, 14, 15, 16

  PRESENT PERFECT (tajriba, vaqt yo'q) —
     3

  PAST SIMPLE (o'tmish) —
     6, 7, 8, 10, 11, 12, 13


HAR BIRI NEGA:

 1  'Myrrhee ... a small place'
    Doimiy haqiqat → PRESENT SIMPLE. → IS

 2  'Many people ... they ...'
    Doimiy holat → PRESENT SIMPLE. → SAY

 3  'they ... UFOs in the area'
    ⚠ Vaqt AYTILMAGAN, TAJRIBA →
    PRESENT PERFECT. → HAVE SEEN
    (110-bet, 2-kadr: 'some people say they
     HAVE SEEN UFOs' — AYNAN bir xil!)

 4  'the big question ... this'
    → IS

 5  'why ... interested in Myrrhee?'
    Savol, hozirgi holat → ARE ALIENS

 6  'In the LATE 1960'S, Erich von Däniken
    ...'
    ANIQ VAQT → PAST SIMPLE. → COMPARED

 7  'They ... that the ancient Aborigines...'
    O'sha vaqtda → PAST SIMPLE. → SUGGESTED

 8  'the ancient Aborigines ... about aliens'
    QADIMDA → PAST SIMPLE.
    know → KNEW.

 9  'Another interesting point ... that ...'
    Hozirgi fikr → PRESENT SIMPLE. → IS

10  'many Aborigines ... around the area'
    O'tmishda → PAST SIMPLE. → LIVED

11  'before the white man ... in the 18TH
    CENTURY'
    ANIQ VAQT → PAST SIMPLE. → ARRIVED

12  '... about aliens?'
    O'tmish haqida savol → PAST SIMPLE.
    → DID THEY KNOW

13  '... to contact the Aborigines again?'
    O'tmish haqida savol → PAST SIMPLE.
    → DID ALIENS TRY
    ('HAVE ALIENS TRIED' ham mumkin —
     bugungi kungacha bo'lgan davr uchun.)

14  'we ... for sure'
    Hozirgi holat → PRESENT SIMPLE.
    → DON'T KNOW

15  'One thing ... certain'
    → IS

16  'the truth ... still out there'
    → IS


⚠ 3-BAND — UNIT 15 GRAMMATIKASI:
  'they HAVE SEEN UFOs in the area'

  Vaqt AYTILMAGAN → PRESENT PERFECT.

  110-bet, 2-kadr:
     'some people say they HAVE SEEN UFOs'

  Kitob AYNAN shu gapni takrorlagan!


⚠ 12 va 13-BANDLAR — SAVOL ShAKLI:
  'DID they KNOW ...?'
  'DID aliens TRY ...?'

  'DID' dan keyin ASOSIY shakl:
     'Did they KNOW?'  ✓
     'Did they KNEW?'  ✗


DIQQAT — 'THE 18TH CENTURY':
  'in the 18th century' = 18-asrda
  O'qilishi: 'the eighteenth century'.

  Asrlar DOIM 'the' bilan.


DIQQAT — 'FOR SURE':
  'we don't know FOR SURE' = aniq bilmaymiz
  Turg'un ibora.


DIQQAT — 'THOUGH':
  'One thing is certain, THOUGH.'
  'though' bu yerda = 'ammo, lekin'
  va GAP OXIRIDA turadi.

  Grammar 62-bet, 6-mashqdagi xatda ham bor
  edi: 'I'm worried THOUGH, that ...'


DIQQAT — 'THE TRUTH IS OUT THERE':
  Bu — mashhur 'The X-Files' serialining
  shiori.

  'out there' = qayerdadir tashqarida


DIQQAT — 'ABORIGINES':
  Bet ostida kitob izoh bergan:
  '* Aborigines - the original people of
   Australia'
  = Avstraliyaning tub aholisi

  'aboriginal' — sifat shakli.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  New South Wales = Yangi Janubiy Uels
                    (Avstraliya shtati)
  an area      = hudud
  interested in = ... bilan qiziquvchi
  in the late 1960's = 1960-yillar oxirida
  to compare ... to ... = ... ni ... ga
                 qiyoslamoq
  ancient      = qadimiy
  Aborigines   = Avstraliya tub aholisi
  a rock painting = qoya rasmi
  a description = tasvir, ta'rif
  to suggest   = taxmin qilmoq
  a point      = jihat, fikr
  the white man = oq tanlilar
  the 18th century = 18-asr
  to contact   = aloqaga chiqmoq
  unfortunately = afsuski
  for sure     = aniq
  certain      = aniq, shubhasiz
  though       = ammo (gap oxirida)
  the truth    = haqiqat
  out there    = qayerdadir

items.sentence: 1  Myrrhee ........... (be) a small place near the town of Moyhu in New South Wales, Australia.
items.uz: Myrrhee — Avstraliyaning Yangi Janubiy Uels shtatidagi kichik joy.

commonMistake.whyUz:
Doimiy holat → PRESENT SIMPLE.

Ega 'Many people' — KO'PLIK → -S QO'SHILMAYDI
('says' XATO).

⚠ UNIT 15 GRAMMATIKASI:
Vaqt AYTILMAGAN, TAJRIBA → PRESENT PERFECT.

110-bet, 2-kadr AYNAN shu gap:
'some people say they HAVE SEEN UFOs'

see → saw → SEEN (V3).

Hozirgi holat → PRESENT SIMPLE.
'the big question' — BIRLIK → IS.

items.uz: — nega o'zga sayyoraliklar Myrrhee bilan qiziqadi?

commonMistake.whyUz:
Hozirgi holat haqida SAVOL → PRESENT SIMPLE.

'aliens' — KO'PLIK → ARE.
Savolda 'be' EGADAN OLDIN:
'why ARE ALIENS interested?'

'interested IN' — predlog 'in'.

items.sentence: 6  In the late 1960's, Erich von Däniken ......................... (compare) some ancient Aboriginal rock paintings to modern descriptions of aliens.
items.uz: 1960-yillar oxirida Erix fon Deniken qadimiy aborigen qoya rasmlarini o'zga sayyoraliklarning zamonaviy tasviriga qiyoslagan.

commonMistake.whyUz:
KALIT: 'In the late 1960'S' — ANIQ VAQT
→ PAST SIMPLE.

compare → COMPARED (to'g'ri fe'l).
'compare A TO B' — predlog 'to'.

items.uz: Ular qadimgi aborigenlar ... deb taxmin qilishgan

commonMistake.whyUz:
6-band bilan BIR XIL vaqtda (1960-yillar)
→ PAST SIMPLE.

suggest → SUGGESTED (to'g'ri fe'l).

items.uz: ... qadimgi aborigenlar o'zga sayyoraliklar haqida bilgan.

commonMistake.whyUz:
QADIMDA sodir bo'lgan → PAST SIMPLE.

know → KNEW (noto'g'ri fe'l).

'ANCIENT' = qadimiy — o'tmish ko'rsatkichi.

Muallifning HOZIRGI fikri → PRESENT SIMPLE.

'Another interesting point' — BIRLIK → IS.

DIQQAT: matn o'tmish haqida bo'lsa ham,
MUALLIFNING gapi hozirgi zamonda.

items.sentence: 10  ... many Aborigines .................... (live) around the area of Myrrhee

commonMistake.whyUz:
O'TMISHDA sodir bo'lgan (oq tanlilar
kelishidan oldin) → PAST SIMPLE.

live → LIVED (to'g'ri fe'l).

items.sentence: 11  before the white man ................ (arrive) in the 18th century.

commonMistake.whyUz:
KALIT: 'in the 18TH CENTURY' — ANIQ VAQT
→ PAST SIMPLE.

arrive → ARRIVED.

'the 18th century' — asrlar DOIM 'the' bilan.

O'TMISH haqida savol → PAST SIMPLE.

⚠ 'DID' dan keyin ASOSIY shakl:
  'Did they KNOW?'  ✓
  'Did they KNEW?'  ✗

items.uz: O'zga sayyoraliklar aborigenlar bilan yana aloqaga chiqmoqchi bo'lganmi?

commonMistake.whyUz:
12-band bilan bir xil — O'TMISH haqida savol
→ PAST SIMPLE.

'DID aliens TRY' (ASOSIY shakl).

DIQQAT: 'HAVE aliens TRIED ...?' ham mumkin
— bugungi kungacha bo'lgan davr uchun.
Ikkalasi ham qabul qilinadi.

'to contact' = aloqaga chiqmoq.

HOZIRGI holat → PRESENT SIMPLE INKOR.

'know' — his/aqliy fe'l, Continuous
BO'LMAYDI.

'for sure' = aniq (turg'un ibora).

HOZIRGI holat → PRESENT SIMPLE.
'One thing' — BIRLIK → IS.

'THOUGH' = ammo — GAP OXIRIDA turadi
(Grammar 62-betdagi xatda ham bor edi).

HOZIRGI holat → PRESENT SIMPLE.

⚠ 'The truth is out there' — mashhur
'The X-Files' serialining shiori.

'STILL' = hali ham ('to be' dan KEYIN).
'out there' = qayerdadir tashqarida.

wordFormation.introUz: 113-bet — transport, bog'lovchilar va Avstraliya tarixi lug'ati.

items.derivedUz: They are driving BECAUSE they want to write.
They see a spaceship, SO David asks ...
The jeep slows down, BUT they don't know why.

items.derived: A, SO B  =  B BECAUSE A

patterns.exampleEn: They are driving because they want to write a story. They see a spaceship, so David asks Sandra to take pictures. The jeep slows down, but they don't know why.
patterns.exampleUz: Ular haydashmoqda, chunki maqola yozmoqchi. Kemani ko'rishdi, shuning uchun surat olishdi. Jip sekinlashdi, lekin sababi noma'lum.
patterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 'BECAUSE' va 'SO' — TARTIBI TESKARI:
'A, SO B' = 'B BECAUSE A'.

patterns.formula: ... is a PRIMITIVE / MODERN means of transport.
patterns.exampleEn: A cart is a primitive means of transport. An aeroplane is a modern means of transport.
patterns.exampleUz: Arava — ibtidoiy transport vositasi. Samolyot — zamonaviy transport vositasi.

patterns.exampleEn: Many people say they have seen UFOs in the area.
patterns.exampleUz: Ko'p odamlar bu hududda NUJOlarni ko'rganini aytishadi.
patterns.explanationUz:
⚠ PRESENT PERFECT — vaqt aytilmagan, tajriba.
110-betdagi hikoyada AYNAN shu gap bor.

patterns.exampleEn: Did they know about aliens? Did aliens try to contact the Aborigines again?
patterns.exampleUz: Ular o'zga sayyoraliklar haqida bilganmi? O'zga sayyoraliklar yana aloqaga chiqmoqchi bo'lganmi?
patterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 'DID' dan keyin ASOSIY shakl:
'Did they KNOW?' ✓ / 'Did they KNEW?' ✗

patterns.exampleEn: He doesn't remember using the camera. I don't remember taking them.
patterns.exampleUz: U fotoapparatdan foydalanganini eslamaydi. Men ularni olganimni eslamayman.
patterns.explanationUz:
'remember DOING' = qilganini eslamoq
(ish QILINGAN);
'remember TO DO' = qilishni eslamoq
(ish hali qilinmagan).
